pages.title: Stilt-Legged Horse
pages.text: The stilt-legged horse ($(o)Haringtonhippus francisci$()) lived across North America, from the Yukon to southern Mexico, during the Pleistocene.$(br2)It was a small, slender horse with long, very thin lower legs, built more like a wild ass than a true horse.$(br2)Ancient DNA showed in 2017 that it was a separate lineage from true horses, though some scientists still place it in $(o)Equus$(). It died out about 12,000 years ago.
